notes: Older BCPL announcement pages were not available, so past application windows are not confirmed here.
name: Teen Service Learning (Be Involved, Teen Advisory Boards, Buddies)
what_you_do: Earn service-learning hours with drop-in community projects, by joining a Teen Advisory Board, or by helping younger kids read and do STEM projects as a Buddy.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page's teen event filter lists ages 14 to 17. Be Involved is open to any teen at any branch. Teen Advisory Boards and Buddies use applications.
duration: Be Involved is drop-in. Teen Advisory Board and Buddies dates are not posted on this page.
deadline_text: Be Involved is drop-in with no application. Teen Advisory Board and Buddies dates are not posted on this page.
how_to_apply: For Be Involved, check the events calendar and drop in. For Teen Advisory Boards or Buddies, contact your local branch. Questions: yfe@bcpl.net.
